verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 ships management software (health-monitoring CLI, nvidia-smi, BMC with Redfish/IPMI/SNMP/web UI, and Mission Control), so asking whether it can be operated through natural-language commands is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows only conventional command-line, protocol and web interfaces, with no natural-language operation. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes make documentation readable by AI agents; they do not let a user operate the system in natural language.
